<thought>Based on the observed 1 Da spacing and the relative intensities (M+1 ≈ 11 % of the base peak, M+2 ≈ 0.5 %), the pattern matches the natural isotopic distribution of carbon (13C ≈ 1.1 % per atom). No significant M+2 peaks characteristic of chlorine, bromine, or sulfur are present, so only carbon can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
